The '''''Resolve''''' was a [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] that was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the veteran Alliance [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cov (Duros)|Cov]]. At some point during the conflict, a number of the ''Resolve''{{'s}} crew were bought out by the [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]-based distribution firm [[DurAble]] and they mutineed against Cov.<ref name="CCW" />
